description: Integrate the canonical real Decider adapter with six directly invoked Strands-registered tools, the bounded production coordinator, terminal safety behavior, CLI, and optional no-tools Bedrock explanation. This depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Implement ToolServices, six exact keyword-only @tool closures, LocalTestDoubleModel, real Strands Agent registration, fixed direct agent.tool dispatch, local explainer, and real no-tools Bedrock explainer.
Implement SimshiftDeciderAdapter using the FEAT-001 client for trusted manifest/health checks, retries, projection, response conversion, and tracing; do not add a production fake.
Implement model_choice/effective_choice policy, runner budgets, proposal/approval/transition/check orchestration, and argparse run/policy-check/validate-fixtures commands.
Make every final profile-gate denial terminal: proposal_blocked followed by run_escalated(PROFILE_PROPOSAL_BLOCKED), no second Decider call, proposal, or tool dispatch.

Add unit/integration tests proving all six causal routes, zero host/Bedrock model calls before or during dispatch, complete approved BR recovery, and OFFLINE forced-proposal MANAGEMENT_UNREACHABLE blocking with unchanged state.
acceptance_criteria: Each admissible returned label invokes exactly the matching registered Strands tool once, with no Bedrock tool selection.
The local tool-host model is labeled LOCAL_TEST_DOUBLE and invocation count zero while strands_framework_dispatch is REAL.
Approved deterministic BR reaches RESTORED only after both checks; OFFLINE forced profile evaluation returns BLOCKED/MANAGEMENT_UNREACHABLE with no transition or profile mutation.
Denied BR creates exactly one proposal and blocked audit, emits PROFILE_PROPOSAL_BLOCKED escalation, and performs no second model/tool call.
Production code contains no fake Decider and local-double mode still requires the real loopback Decider service.
